from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
import json
import sys

home = Path.home()
task_id = "DEV-PRED-CONT-INFLIGHT-RECOVERY-INSTALL-20261002-E004"
state_path = home / ".local/state/prediction-command-bus/tasks" / f"{task_id}.json"
wake_dir = home / ".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
ext_dir = wake_dir / "browser_extension"
manager_path = wake_dir / "continuation_manager.py"
server_path = wake_dir / "bridge_server.py"

assert state_path.is_file(), f"E004 task state missing: {state_path}"
state = json.loads(state_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
print("E004_COMMAND_STATE=" + str(state.get("status")))
print("E004_HTTP_STATUS=" + str(state.get("http_status")))
print("E004_RESPONSE=" + str(state.get("response", ""))[:1200])
assert state.get("status") == "DISPATCHED", state

assert manager_path.is_file()
manager_text = manager_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert "continuation_abandoned" in manager_text
assert "DELIVERY_AMBIGUOUS" in manager_text
print("INSTALLED_STALE_INFLIGHT_CODE=PASS")

sys.path.insert(0, str(wake_dir))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("installed_bridge_e005", server_path)
wake = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
assert spec.loader is not None
spec.loader.exec_module(wake)
print("WAKE_HANDLER=" + str(getattr(wake.Handler, "server_version", "")))
assert "continuation-v2" in str(getattr(wake.Handler, "server_version", ""))
assert hasattr(wake.base, "INFLIGHT")
print("GENERIC_INFLIGHT_PATCH=PRESERVED")

manifest_path = ext_dir / "manifest.json"
content_path = ext_dir / "content.js"
background_path = ext_dir / "background.js"
assert manifest_path.is_file() and content_path.is_file() and background_path.is_file()
manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
content = content_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
background = background_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
print("STAGED_EXTENSION_VERSION=" + str(manifest.get("version")))
assert manifest.get("version") == "1.0.0"
assert 'const CONTENT_VERSION = "1.0.0";' in content
assert 'const RUNTIME_VERSION = "1.0.0";' in background
assert "async function pollWake()" in content
assert "exactUserTurnCount" in content
print("STAGED_CHROME_WAKE=PASS")
print("TAMPERMONKEY_REQUIRED=NO")
print("RUNTIME_VERIFY_E005=PASS")
